It fairly shows Mexico's non-nuclear posture and civilian nuclear safety context, but not enough direct command, regulatory, or crisis-management evidence to distinguish personal responsibility."},{"chapter_id":"2B","decision":"targeted_follow_up","remove_or_contextualize":[],"material_gaps":[{"gap":"No Mexico-originating war, coercive-security, or peace-negotiation authority is evidenced, so the file is mostly diplomacy and humanitarian posture around Ukraine.","lenses":["2B.2","2B.4","2B.5","2B.9","2B.10"],"best_source_or_query_direction":"Mexican defense, foreign-ministry, and treaty records that would show direct security choices, plus UN vote explanations and any formal policy on sanctions, arms, or security cooperation.","why_it_matters":"Without a real security lever, the chapter risks overstating rhetoric and limited diplomatic positioning as substantive peace conduct."}],"reason":"The package is fair as a limited-exposure case, but it remains mostly diplomatic positioning rather than a ruler-originating international-security choice with operational leverage. It can support a null or cautious presentation, yet it still needs tighter evidence on actual peace/security decisions."},{"chapter_id":"3B","decision":"pass","remove_or_contextualize":[],"material_gaps":[],"reason":"The dossier fairly balances state violence, protest repression, surveillance, accountability failures, and remedial steps, while separating federal conduct from local incidents and allegation-only material. It presents both adverse and mitigating evidence with enough attribution discipline for a fair chapter read."},{"chapter_id":"4B","decision":"targeted_follow_up","remove_or_contextualize":[{"evidence_id":"E0040","reason":"Subnational election results are useful context, but they are not direct proof of AMLO's national-level conduct."},{"evidence_id":"E0043","reason":"The Pegasus evidence spans 2019-2021 and the customer attribution is incomplete, so it should be treated as retrospective context rather than direct proof of AMLO ordering the intrusion."},{"evidence_id":"E0045","reason":"The biometric-registry ruling is a judicial constraint on a government-backed proposal, not direct evidence of ruler conduct."}],"material_gaps":[{"gap":"Direct evidence on appointments and control over autonomous institutions is still thin, especially for the strongest capture mechanisms.","lenses":["4B.4","4B.5","4B.8"],"best_source_or_query_direction":"INE, INAI, CNDH, and other autonomous-body appointment records; budget and staffing records; and formal legislative or executive documents on institutional design changes in 2022.","why_it_matters":"The package shows pressure and rhetoric, but not enough direct control evidence to fully discriminate between contested reform politics and deeper institutional capture."},{"gap":"The surveillance chain-of-command remains under-attributed.","lenses":["4B.6","4B.9"],"best_source_or_query_direction":"Court files, investigative findings, defense ministry documents, and any official inquiry into Pegasus or related surveillance procurement and authorization chains.","why_it_matters":"The chapter needs better proof of who authorized or tolerated the surveillance pattern, not just evidence that it existed."}],"reason":"The package captures pressure on media and electoral institutions, but some of the strongest negatives still rest on contested attribution or judicial constraint. It is good on atmosphere and conflict, weaker on direct command responsibility and institutional-appointment evidence."},{"chapter_id":"5B","decision":"pass","remove_or_contextualize":[],"material_gaps":[],"reason":"The package fairly balances macro stability, investment uncertainty, social spending, and adverse structural evidence, using a mix of independent and official sources. It separates plans, implementation, and outcomes well enough for a fair 5B read."},{"chapter_id":"6B","decision":"pass","remove_or_contextualize":[],"material_gaps":[],"reason":"The dossier gives a solid picture of program design, rollout, and some independent welfare signals, while acknowledging that outcome evidence is thinner than implementation evidence. The package fairly presents both positive delivery and unresolved quality/coverage limits."},{"chapter_id":"7B","decision":"targeted_follow_up","remove_or_contextualize":[{"evidence_id":"E0024","reason":"The press-attack aggregate is broader state-environment evidence and should not be treated as direct proof of AMLO's personal dishonesty or self-enrichment."},{"evidence_id":"E0043","reason":"The Citizen Lab item is attribution-limited and spans pre-2022 conduct, so it is stronger as surveillance context than as personal-nexus evidence."},{"evidence_id":"E0074","reason":"The European Parliament resolution is political monitoring, not a finding of personal wrongdoing."},{"evidence_id":"E0078","reason":"The SFP conclusion is an absence-of-evidence finding with jurisdictional limits; it should be used as contrary context, not proof of innocence."},{"evidence_id":"E0079","reason":"The Banxico pressure story is weakly sourced and should be treated as suggestive, not as strong proof of favoritism."},{"evidence_id":"E0080","reason":"This is a late-2021 factbox and its competence-versus-loyalty inference is indirect, so it should not carry heavy 2022 personal-integrity weight."}],"material_gaps":[{"gap":"Direct personal-benefit evidence is still thin.","lenses":["7B.3","7B.4","7B.9"],"best_source_or_query_direction":"Asset declarations, procurement and licensing records, tax or campaign-finance filings, and documented benefit flows to AMLO or close family from 2022.","why_it_matters":"The current file has more hostility and controversy than hard proof of personal enrichment or concealed self-dealing."},{"gap":"Independent corroboration of surveillance or retaliation orders is incomplete.","lenses":["7B.2","7B.6","7B.7","7B.8","7B.10"],"best_source_or_query_direction":"Court findings, investigative reports, internal documents, and official inquiries on Pegasus, media retaliation, and any correction/retraction record for contested presidential claims.","why_it_matters":"The chapter needs clearer proof of knowing deception or obstruction, not only a hostile information environment."}],"reason":"The dossier is directionally correct on hostility, retaliation, and appointment pressure, but the personal-nexus evidence for dishonesty, self-dealing, and obstruction remains uneven. Several important items are allegation-level, retrospective, or only indirectly attributable to AMLO."},{"chapter_id":"8B","decision":"targeted_follow_up","remove_or_contextualize":[{"evidence_id":"E0046","reason":"The IMF macro assessment is useful context, but much of it reflects external shocks and inherited conditions rather than direct execution evidence."},{"evidence_id":"E0047","reason":"The OECD survey is strong background, but its weaknesses are partly pre-existing and not direct proof of AMLO execution quality."},{"evidence_id":"E0056","reason":"This is a retrospective 2023 summary of 2022 poverty and health outcomes, so it should be treated as outcome context rather than contemporaneous execution evidence."},{"evidence_id":"E0057","reason":"This is a later retrospective overview, so it is useful context but not clean 2022 execution evidence."},{"evidence_id":"E0089","reason":"This is a self-reported results report and needs independent corroboration before it can carry heavy execution weight."},{"evidence_id":"E0090","reason":"The AIFA launch claim is self-reported and should be treated as an opening-stage execution claim, not as proof of durable success."},{"evidence_id":"E0094","reason":"The IMF Article IV note is macro context more than direct implementation evidence for AMLO's program."},{"evidence_id":"E0097","reason":"The subsidy counterfactual is an official estimate and should be used as policy rationale context, not validated outcome proof."}],"material_gaps":[{"gap":"Independent outcome audits for the flagship programs remain insufficient.","lenses":["8B.6","8B.7","8B.10"],"best_source_or_query_direction":"External audits, independent evaluations, and post-launch performance studies for AIFA, Dos Bocas, IMSS-Bienestar, La Escuela es Nuestra, and PACIC.","why_it_matters":"The chapter currently documents implementation more strongly than durable success or failure."},{"gap":"Attribution still needs better separation between AMLO's choices and inherited macro conditions or external shocks.","lenses":["8B.2","8B.5","8B.9"],"best_source_or_query_direction":"Budget execution records, cabinet-level implementation memos, and independent econometric or program-evaluation work that isolates ruler-period effects from shocks and legacy trends.","why_it_matters":"Without cleaner attribution, the file risks crediting or debiting AMLO for outcomes that were only partly under his control."}],"reason":"The package is useful for implementation evidence, but it leans too heavily on self-reporting and macro context. Independent audits and stronger causal attribution are still needed for the flagship projects and for durable 2022 performance claims."}]}
